title: hotfix: SLO enforcer backoff causing regional failover thrashing - load-shedding tuning and guardrails
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: During the incident on 2026-02-27 we observed the SLO enforcer backoff policy oscillating across regions under a cross-region capacity pressure pattern, which triggered cascading regional failovers and aggressive load-shedding. This hotfix stabilizes the backoff state machine, introduces hysteresis and per-region cooldown windows, and tightens load-shedding thresholds to prevent thrashing. Changes are conservative and feature-flagged to allow rapid rollback. Summary of changes: 1) Fix race in slo_enforcer/backoff_manager where concurrent recovery and backoff timers could reset each other, leading to repeated failovers; 2) Add per-region cooldown (configurable) and jitter to backoff increments; 3) Increase minimum grace tokens for KV-cache-backed requests to reduce unnecessary shedding for warm sessions; 4) Add metrics and tracing spans to make the backoff decisions observable (enforcer.backoff.{region,state,reason}); 5) Add e2e stress test to perf-canary harness to reproduce regional thrash pattern and ensure guardrails hold. Rollout plan: merge to main, deploy feature-flag default off in prod for 1 hour (smoke), then enable in a single low-traffic region for 30 minutes, monitor SLOs and enforcer metrics, then enable globally if stable. Revert plan: flip feature flag off and rollback main if metrics regress for >5 minutes after enabling. Related: ENG-9231 (investigation), SUP-4217 (customer incident). Checklist: [x] Reproduced issue in perf-canary harness [x] Unit tests added for timer behavior [x] Integration tests for regional cooldown [x] Metrics and tracing added [x] Docs/ops runbook updated [x] Smoke rollout plan documented

release_notes: Hotfix: Stabilize SLO enforcer backoff to prevent regional failover thrashing under cross-region capacity pressure. Adds per-region cooldown, jitter, increased grace threshold for cache-backed requests, and observability for backoff decisions. Rollout gated behind feature flag.
rollout_plan: Feature-flag off on merge, 1h smoke in prod with flag off, enable in single low-traffic region for 30m, then global enable if no regression. Monitor enforcer.backoff.* metrics and SLO error budget burn. Revert by flipping feature flag off and rolling back if needed.

Notify on-call SRE and cust-success if any customer-facing errors observed

notes: This PR is intentionally conservative due to incident impact. Majority of changes are behavior guards and observability. We will follow up with a small set of performance optimizations after stability is confirmed.
